newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-SOUTH AFRICA GAMBLE ON INJURED MULDER.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-SOUTH AFRICA GAMBLE ON INJURED MULDER.

text.p: South Africa's selectors have gambled on the fitness of centre Japie Mulder by adding him to their squad of 25 which will fly to Australia on Thursday to continue the Tri-Nations series.
Mulder aggravated a shoulder injury during the recent series against the British Lions and has not played for a month.
Hooker James Dalton, who missed Saturday's Tri-Nations match again New Zealand at Ellis Park with an ankle injury, will face a fitness test on Tuesday.
If he does not pass it, Chris Rossouw, will be drafted into the squad.
South Africa will play their second Tri-Nations match against Australia in Brisbane on August 2. The following week they take on the All Blacks in Auckland.

Squad: Russell Bennett, Andre Snyman, Percy Montgomery, Danie van Schalkwyk, Pieter Rossouw, Jannie de Beer, Joost van der Westhuizen, Gary Teichmann (captain), Andre Venter, Ruben Kruger, Mark Andrews, Krynauw Otto, Marius Hurter, Naka Drotske, Os du Randt,Henry Honiball, James Small, Werner Swanepoel, Fritz van Heerden, Dawie Theron, James Dalton or Chris Rossouw, Japie Mulder, Hannes Strydom, Johan Erasmus, Adrian Garvey, Warren Brosnihan.
